01 /

Prepare your details

The standard form asks for your legal name, date of birth, country, residential address, document type and number, an identity document and a selfie. You must be at least 18 and consent to administrator review.

  • Identity document: JPG, PNG or PDF, up to 2 MB.
  • Selfie: JPG or PNG, up to 2 MB.
  • Use clear, readable files and accurate information.
02 /

Follow your account’s requirements

An administrator can assign additional verification layers to individual accounts. Your page shows the reason for verification, required fields and any additional uploads. Requirements can differ between users; complete the form shown on your own account.

03 /

Submit for review

A submitted verification remains pending until an administrator approves or rejects it. A rejection includes a reason so you can prepare a new submission. Pending documents cannot be silently replaced, and approval is not automatic.

04 /

Keep documents in the right place

Submit documents only through the signed-in verification page. Files are stored privately and encrypted, with access restricted to the owner and authorised administrators. Email verification codes confirm access to an inbox; they do not replace KYC approval.
